## Mission 
The **Democracy and Political Violence Conference & Working Group** convenes researchers
working on political violence and (anti-)democratic attitudes. Our first conference will be held at
Harvard University in Cambridge, MA before APSA 2026.

## Organizers

The conference is organized by **Sam Fuller**, **Gal Bitton**, and **Jack T. Rametta**.

## Questions, comments, concerns

Have a question, or want to share information or feedback? Please reach out to the
organizers.
